title: AH Audits & Certifications
description:

**Key Result Areas/Accountabilities**
**Supporting Actions**
NADCAP, ISO 9001:2015, 14001:2015, 45001:2015, NABL and AS9100 systems.
  
  
To lead, implement, maintain, and continually improve the organization’s certified management systems and accreditations, ensuring ongoing compliance with ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 17025 (NABL), AS9100, Nadcap, ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and ISO/IEC 27001, and to manage all internal, external, customer, and regulatory audits effectively.
  
  
Metallurgical Laboratory Operations
  
  
Lead and manage all metallurgical laboratory activities including Chemical Analysis, Mechanical Testing, Metallography, Failure Analysis and Heat Treatment evaluation. Ensure laboratory compliance with Nadcap, AMS, ASTM, ISO, and customer?specific requirements. Develop, review, and approve laboratory procedures, test methods, and work instructions. Oversee calibration and maintenance of laboratory equipment. Ensure data integrity, traceability, and proper test documentation.
  
  
Management System & Certification and Audit Management
  
  
Establish, implement, maintain, and improve ISO 9001, AS9100, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, and ISO/IEC 27001 management systems.
  
  
Ensure NABL ISO/IEC 17025 compliance for laboratory operations, including scope management and method validation.
  
  
Lead Nadcap accreditation activities and ensure sustained compliance to PRI requirements.
  
  
Lead product and process qualification activities for aerospace customers and programs. Prepare and review qualification plans, reports, First Article Inspection (FAI – AS9102), and material/process capability studies.
  
  
Plan, conduct, and coordinate internal audits across all applicable standards. Coordinate and manage external audits (Certification Body, NABL, Nadcap, customer, regulatory). Ensure audit readiness, agenda preparation, evidence availability, and effective auditor engagement. Track audit findings, NCRs, observations, and OFIs through to effective closure.
  
  
Customer Interface
  
  
Visit to Customers for understanding customer perceptions. Understand Customer process and applications. Provide inputs for developing customer specific practices. Develop / modify products based on customer inputs. Develop new products, markets based on customer requirements, applications etc. Analyze customer complaints and implement systematic action plan to avoid the repetition of complaints.
  
  
NPD & Expand market in Aerospace, defense segments

Documentation & Control
  
  
Develop, review, and approve SOPs, procedures, manuals, formats, and records.
  
  
Ensure document and record control aligns with certification and accreditation requirements.
  
  
Maintain master lists for standards, specifications, customer requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  
  
Upgradation of testing lab and development of testing personal
  
  
To upgrade the testing lab and development of testing personal to meet NABL and NADCAP requirements.

title: Servicenow Consultant
description:
**Company Description**
Zynder Tech Private Limited is a technology services company focused on delivering robust, scalable, and secure enterprise solutions. The organization specializes in implementing and optimizing platforms like ServiceNow to streamline business processes and IT operations. Zynder Tech emphasizes quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement, providing clients with tailored solutions that align with their strategic goals. Team members work in a professional environment that values learning, innovation, and customer success.
  
**Role Description**
The Servicenow Consultant will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing ServiceNow modules to support business and IT service management processes. Day-to-day activities include gathering and analyzing requirements, developing custom workflows, scripting, and integrations, as well as troubleshooting and optimizing existing ServiceNow implementations. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, preparing technical documentation, and providing user training and support to ensure effective platform adoption. This is an on-site role based in Kerala, India, requiring close coordination with internal stakeholders and clients to deliver high-quality solutions.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Software Development, including scripting within ServiceNow and working with relevant frameworks.
* Candidates should possess skills in IT Service Management, with hands-on experience in ServiceNow ITSM modules and related best practices.
* Candidates should possess skills in Project Management to plan, coordinate, and deliver ServiceNow implementations within scope and timelines.
* Candidates should possess skills in Integration, including connecting ServiceNow with third-party systems and using APIs or middleware tools.
* Candidates should possess skills working with Databases, including understanding data models, queries, and performance considerations.
* Experience with ServiceNow certification (e.g., Certified System Administrator, Implementation Specialist) is highly beneficial.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with attention to detail and quality in configuration and documentation.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work in a structured on-site environment in Kerala, India.
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Quality Assurance Team Lead
description:
We are looking for a
**proactive and detail-oriented QA Lead**
to manage our QA team and ensure software quality through effective manual and automation testing. The ideal candidate should have strong technical expertise, leadership skills, and the ability to mentor team members. Knowledge of AI-powered testing tools is an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead, manage, and mentor the QA team, ensuring effective task allocation and continuous skill development.
* Plan and oversee manual and automation testing for web and mobile applications.
* Develop and maintain test plans, test cases, automation scripts, and testing frameworks.
* Manage functional, regression, integration, API, and performance testing.
* Collaborate with development and DevOps teams to improve testing processes and release quality.
* Track defects, analyze test results, and maintain QA reports.
* Explore AI-powered testing tools to improve testing efficiency and coverage.

Required Skills

* 5+ years of experience in software testing, covering both manual and automation testing.
* Proven experience in QA team leadership and mentoring.
* Hands-on experience with Selenium, Java, TestNG, Appium, or similar tools.
* Good understanding of testing methodologies, API testing, SQL, and Agile/DevOps practices.
* Familiarity with AI-powered testing tools or AI-assisted test automation.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

title: Calibration Engineer
description:
Biomedical Equipment Calibration Engineer is responsible for performing calibration, testing, and validation of medical devices to ensure accuracy, reliability, and compliance with regulatory standards. The role involves hands\-on technical work, documentation, and coordination with hospital staff to maintain equipment performance and patient safety.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Calibration \& Validation: Perform scheduled calibration of biomedical equipment such as ventilators, patient monitors, infusion pumps, and other critical devices as per OEM and regulatory standards.
* Testing \& Troubleshooting: Conduct functional, performance, and electrical safety testing using calibration tools (e.g., safety analyzers, simulators) and resolve minor technical issues.
* Compliance \& Documentation: Prepare and maintain calibration reports, certificates, and service records in line with NABH, ISO, and NABL requirements.
* Audit Support: Assist in internal and external audits by ensuring documentation accuracy and equipment traceability.
* Coordination: Work closely with service teams, hospital staff, and senior engineers for calibration planning and issue resolution.
* Training Support: Provide basic guidance to users on proper handling and routine care of medical equipment.



  





**Skills \& Qualification** 




  




* Diploma / B.Tech in Biomedical Engineering, Electronics, or related field
* Minimum 1\+ years of experience in biomedical equipment calibration (Mandatory)
* Good understanding of biomedical equipment and calibration procedures
* Familiarity with ISO 13485, NABH, NABL, and healthcare safety standards
* Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting skills
* Attention to detail and accuracy in documentation
* Good communication and coordination skills
* Certification in medical equipment calibration (Preferred)

title: Quality Assurance Manager
description:
**Job description:** 




 The Quality Assurance Manager is a senior function within ACET Migrations responsible for owning the full documentation quality lifecycle across Australian migration services. This role ensures every client file lodged by ACET Migrations meets the required accuracy, compliance, and regulatory standards set by Australian immigration authorities. The QA Manager leads the quality team, drives process consistency, and holds accountability for submission outcomes across all visa categories.
 



**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 1\. Setting the Quality Standard
 



 –Builds a clear system for how documents should be checked and approved
 



 –Sets the rules and targets the QA team works toward
 



 –Makes sure everyone on the team knows what good looks like and works to reach it
 



 –Steps in to help any team member who is struggling or unsure
 



 2\. Checking Files Before Submission
 



 –Reviews every file before it is sent to the immigration authority
 



 –Makes sure each file meets current Australian immigration requirements
 



 –Gives final approval — nothing gets lodged without QA sign\-off
 



 3\. Keeping Up With Immigration Rules
 



 –Stays on top of any changes to Australian immigration laws and guidelines
 



 –Updates the team quickly whenever rules change
 



 –Makes sure the team is always working with the most current requirements
 



 4\. Improving How Things Work
 



 –Creates clear step\-by\-step processes for the team to follow
 



 –Spots where things are going wrong and fixes them properly
 



 –Makes sure the same mistakes do not keep happening
 



 5\. Reducing Errors and Rejections
 



 –Tracks where errors and rejections are coming from
 



 –Investigates every rejection to understand why it happened
 



 –Puts steps in place so the same issue does not happen again
 



 –Works toward getting files right the first time, every time
 



 6\. Reporting to Leadership
 



 –Keeps track of how each team member and the overall team is performing
 



 –Prepares clear reports on submission quality, errors, and trends
 



 –Shares findings and suggestions with senior management regularly
 



 7\. Working With Other Teams
 



 –Works alongside case managers, migration agents, and operations staff
 



 –Makes sure quality is not just a QA job — it runs through the whole business
 



 –Gets involved in cases that are complicated or carry higher risk
 



 8\. Training the Team
 



 –Runs training sessions to help the team improve their documentation skills
 



 –Teaches the team about any new immigration rules or process changes
 



 –Builds a team culture where everyone cares about quality, not just the QA Manager
 



 9\. Protecting Client Information
 



 –Makes sure all client data is handled safely and kept private
 



 –Follows all legal and company rules around data protection
 



**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 –Has a relevant degree
 



 –Has 3 to 5 years or more working in Australian migration services
 



 –Has led a QA or compliance team for at least 2 to 3 years
 



 –Knows Australian immigration visa types and what each one requires
 



 –Has used case management or CRM systems before
 



 –Experience across PR, work visas, and student visas is a bonus
 



 Work Location: In person
